input: Declutter and donate my digital photo duplicates

gold.taskTitle: Declutter and donate digital photo duplicates
gold.taskDescription: Identify, remove duplicate digital photos, and donate or share the cleaned-up collection in some meaningful way.

questions.title: Where are your photos stored right now?
questions.description: Understand the storage locations involved, such as a local hard drive, phone, cloud service like Google Photos or iCloud, or external drive.

questions.title: How many photos are we roughly talking about?
questions.description: Get a sense of the scale of the collection to determine the effort and tools needed.

questions.title: What does donate mean to you in this context?
questions.description: Clarify whether donate means giving photos to family members, contributing to a public archive, a charity, or something else entirely.

questions.title: Do you want to manually review or automate duplicate detection?
questions.description: Determine whether the user prefers hands-on control over each decision or wants software to handle the detection automatically.

questions.title: What counts as a duplicate to you specifically?
questions.description: Clarify the definition, for example exact byte-for-byte copies, near-identical shots from a burst, or edited versions of the same original.

questions.title: Are there specific date ranges or events to focus on first?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to tackle the whole library at once or prioritise certain folders, years, or events.

questions.title: What is your deadline or target completion date?
questions.description: Understand any time pressure or personal timeline the user has in mind for finishing this task.
